definitions.gloss: the number of patients (with a particular illness, at a hospital, in a region, etc.)
definitions.explanation: A statistical noun for a count of patients. Combines {患者|かんじゃ} ("patient") with the productive suffix ~{数|すう} ("number of, count of"). Heard most often in news reports and medical statistics — for example, the number of patients with a contagious disease, the number of patients at a hospital, or the number of patients in a particular age bracket.

examples.japanese: {患者数|かんじゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of patients is increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{患者数|かんじゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This year's number of flu patients is higher than usual.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{患者数|かんじゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{急激|きゅうげき}→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Once winter arrives, the number of patients at hospitals rises sharply.

examples.japanese: {厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧、⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{患者数|かんじゃすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}している→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare announces the number of infectious-disease patients by prefecture each week.

notes:
{患者数|かんじゃすう} is a routine compound used wherever patient counts are discussed — public health reports, hospital statistics, news coverage of outbreaks. It is built from the everyday word ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧ plus ~⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧, a highly productive suffix for forming "number of X" nouns.

FORMS:
- ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧ ("patient") + ~⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ ("number of, count") → {患者数|かんじゃすう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {患者数|かんじゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ / ⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: the number of patients increases / decreases
- {患者数|かんじゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急増|きゅうぞう}する→急増する：26999_kyuuzousuru⟧: to rise sharply
- {患者数|かんじゃすう}⟦ピーク→ピーク：11174_piiku⟧: peak in patient numbers
- ⟦{累計|るいけい}→累計：08327_ruikei⟧{患者数|かんじゃすう}: cumulative patient count
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧{患者数|かんじゃすう}: number of new patients
- 1⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧あたり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{患者数|かんじゃすう}: number of patients per day

RELATED ~{数|すう} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧: number of people
- ⟦{死者数|ししゃすう}→死者数：30171_shishasuu⟧: number of deaths
- ⟦{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}→感染者数：30152_kansenshasuu⟧: number of infections
- {利用者数|りようしゃすう}: number of users
- {来場者数|らいじょうしゃすう}: number of visitors / attendees

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: a patient (the base noun)
- ⟦{感染者|かんせんしゃ}→感染者：28388_kansensha⟧: an infected person (a more specific term in disease-outbreak contexts)
- {陽性|ようせい}{者数|しゃすう}: number of positive cases (used during the COVID-19 pandemic)
- ⟦{重症|じゅうしょう}→重症：09792_juushou⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: a seriously ill patient

USAGE:
- During major disease outbreaks, the daily {患者数|かんじゃすう} or ⟦{感染者数|かんせんしゃすう}→感染者数：30152_kansenshasuu⟧ becomes a closely watched statistic in Japanese news.
- The ~⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ suffix is freely productive: speakers can readily form new ~⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ compounds (e.g., ⟦{外来|がいらい}→外来：09895_gairai⟧{患者|かんじゃ}{数|すう} "outpatient count") even when those compounds are not formally listed in dictionaries.
